name: Triple capitulation core: extreme-fear + VIX spike + funding flush (NOT any pair)
rationale: Thesis: a genuine cross-market risk flush requires three INDEPENDENT stress axes to agree on the same day — crypto crowd sentiment at an extreme low (fear_greed), equity-vol fear (vix_level elevated), AND a leveraged-positioning capitulation where perp longs are washed out (funding_rate flushed low/negative). Each axis is a different market (spot crowd / equity options / perp leverage), so their simultaneous agreement is rare and high-conviction, not a single tired level. Long-only spot, swing horizon. Disconfirmer: the cohort carries all three two-feature pairs (fear+vix, fear+funding, vix+funding); the triple must beat the BEST pair on deflated Sharpe after 10bps taker. If any pair matches it, the third filter is redundant and this is just an over-filtered pair-in-disguise. Honest FAIL is valid.
catalyst: extreme-fear sentiment + elevated equity VIX + perp-funding flush aligning same day
